title: TPAccess
description: Tpaccess offers more than enough teleporting features
body:
✨ TpAccess – Simple & Secure Teleport Permissions

TpAccess is a lightweight and powerful Minecraft plugin that gives players full control over who can teleport to them. Whether you're running a survival server, SMP, or a private world with friends, TpAccess helps prevent unwanted teleports while keeping things simple and user-friendly.

🔒 Key Features

✅ Toggle Teleport Access
Players can easily enable or disable whether others can teleport to them.

👥 Player-Controlled Permissions
No more unwanted /tp requests — each player decides who can access them.

⚡ Lightweight & Fast
Designed to run smoothly with minimal performance impact.

🔄 Real-Time Updates
Changes apply instantly — no reloads required.

🛠️ Easy to Use Commands
Simple commands make it easy for anyone to use.

💡 Perfect For
Survival servers (SMP)
Private friend groups
Semi-anarchy servers
Any server that wants better teleport control

📜 Example Use
Don’t want random players teleporting to you? Disable access.
Playing with friends? Enable access only when you want.
Running a server? Give players more control and reduce abuse.

⚙️ Compatibility
✔ Minecraft Paper / Spigot
✔ Modern Minecraft versions
✔ Works alongside most plugins
🚀 Why Choose TpAccess?

TpAccess keeps things simple: you control your space. No complicated setups, no confusing configs — just a clean, effective way to manage teleport access on your server.
